first_ticket_title: Take a first ticket to live
first_ticket_intro: A small first ticket, proposed for one of your repositories, followed through its review and your approval to live.
first_ticket_no_workspace: No repository is connected yet. The first ticket needs one to change.
first_ticket_flow_note: The author first proposes its plan, which waits for your Go in the inbox. Then a reviewer, another model, reads the change, and the release waits for your approval. Nothing goes live until you approve it.
first_ticket_now_todo: In Todo. Cleared is starting it.
first_ticket_now_working: The author is making the change.
first_ticket_now_plan: The author proposed its plan. It waits for your Go in the inbox: read it there, then give the Go.
first_ticket_now_review: A reviewer, another model, is reading the change.
first_ticket_now_approval: The review passed. The release waits for your approval in the inbox.
first_ticket_now_merging: Approved. The release lock merges it, then the release watch checks the project.
first_ticket_now_live: Live. Your first ticket went from Todo to production, and the setup is done.
first_ticket_now_stopped: The ticket left the flow: it was set aside or closed. Open it in the Tower to see why.
first_ticket_rolled_back: The release watch rolled it back, so the ticket is back in Todo.
first_ticket_open_plan: Open the plan in the inbox
first_ticket_summary_all: {all} in all: {person} of your time and {machine} of the machine's.
first_ticket_error_no_workspace: No repository is connected yet. Connect one first.
first_ticket_error_unknown_service: This repository is not connected. Pick one from the list.
first_ticket_error_exists: The first ticket is already made. Reload the page to follow it.
first_ticket_error_unsigned: Cleared cannot sign for you yet: its approval signature is missing. Open the owner's step.
first_ticket_error_other: The first ticket could not be made. Try again in a moment.
